```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import pandas as pd
import os
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scvi
import harmonypy as hm
```

```{python}
carpall_one = sc.read("2.carpall_doublets_identified.h5ad")
```

# ensure X layer is set up properly as sce conversion for previous doublet detection can mess with it
```{python}
carpall_one.X = carpall_one.layers["counts"].copy()
```

# identify mito, ribo and hb genes
```{python}
carpall_one.var["mt"] = carpall_one.var_names.str.startswith("MT-")
carpall_one.var["ribo"] = carpall_one.var_names.str.startswith(("RPS", "RPL"))
carpall_one.var["hb"] = carpall_one.var_names.str.contains(r"^HB[ABDEGMQZ]\d*(?!\w)")
```

```{python}
sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(
    carpall_one, qc_vars=["mt", "ribo", "hb"], inplace=True, percent_top=[20], log1p=True
)
carpall_one
```

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    nrows=5,
    ncols=1,
    figsize=(10, 12)
)

vars_ = ["pct_counts_mt", "pct_counts_ribo", "pct_counts_hb", "n_genes_by_counts", "total_counts"]
thresholds = {
    "pct_counts_mt": [25],
    "pct_counts_ribo": [50],
    "pct_counts_hb": [5],
    "n_genes_by_counts": [200,4000],
    "total_counts" : [100,10000]
}

for ax, var in zip(axes, vars_):

    sc.pl.violin(
        carpall_one,
        keys=var,
        groupby="Patient",
        stripplot=False,
        ax=ax,
        show=False
    )

    if var in thresholds:
        for t in thresholds[var]:
            ax.axhline(
                y=t,
                linestyle="--",
                linewidth=1,
                color="red"
            )

    ax.grid(False)

plt.tight_layout()

fig.savefig(
    "pre_qc_violins.png",
    dpi=300,
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.close(fig)
```

```{python}
cell_counts = (
    carpall_one.obs["Patient"]
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index()
)

cell_counts.columns = ["Patient", "n_cells"]
cell_counts
cell_counts.to_csv("patient_cell_counts_pre_qc.csv")
```

```{python}
ax = cell_counts.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(10, 4))

ax.set_xlabel("Patient")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of cells")
ax.set_title("Cells per Patient")

plt.tight_layout()

```

```{python}
carpall_one = carpall_one[(carpall_one.obs['pct_counts_mt'] < 25) & 
    (carpall_one.obs['pct_counts_ribo'] < 50) &
    (carpall_one.obs['pct_counts_hb'] < 10) &
    (carpall_one.obs['total_counts'] > 100) & 
    (carpall_one.obs['total_counts'] < 10000) & 
    (carpall_one.obs['n_genes_by_counts'] > 200) & 
    (carpall_one.obs['n_genes_by_counts'] < 4000), :].copy()
```

```{python}
cell_counts = (
    carpall_one.obs["Patient"]
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index()
)

cell_counts.columns = ["Patient", "n_cells"]
cell_counts
cell_counts.to_csv("patient_cell_counts_post_qc.csv")
```

```{python}
pre = pd.read_csv("patient_cell_counts_pre_qc.csv")
pre = pre.rename(columns = {"n_cells": "counts_pre"})
post = pd.read_csv("patient_cell_counts_post_qc.csv")
post = post.rename(columns = {"n_cells": "counts_post"})
cell_counts = pd.merge(pre, post, how = "inner", on = "Patient")
cell_counts = cell_counts.drop(columns = "Unnamed: 0_x")
cell_counts = cell_counts.drop(columns = "Unnamed: 0_y")
cell_counts = pd.melt(cell_counts, id_vars=["Patient"], var_name="qc_stage", value_name="n_cells")
```

```{python}
plt.close("all")
plt.clf()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

sns.barplot(
    data=cell_counts,
    x="Patient",
    y="n_cells",
    hue="qc_stage",
    ax=ax
)

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("cell_counts_filtering.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
cell_counts = (
    carpall_one.obs[["Patient", "Timepoint_bin"]]
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index(name="n_cells")
)

order = ["Product", "Early", "Mid", "Late"]

plt.close("all")
plt.clf()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

sns.barplot(
    data=cell_counts,
    x="Patient",
    y="n_cells",
    hue="Timepoint_bin",
    hue_order=order,
    ax=ax
)

fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("cell_counts_patient_time.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```


```{python}
sc.pp.normalize_total(carpall_one, target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(carpall_one)
carpall_one.layers['logcounts'] = carpall_one.X.copy()
```

```{python}
carpall_one.obs["cellbender_applied_cat"] = (
    carpall_one.obs["cellbender_applied"]
    .map({True: "Yes", False: "No"})
    .astype("category")
)
```

```{python}
plt.figure()
sns.histplot(
        carpall_one.layers['counts'].sum(1), bins=500, kde=False
    )
plt.show()

plt.figure()
sns.histplot(
        carpall_one.layers['logcounts'].sum(1), bins=500, kde=False
    )
plt.show()
```

```{python}
carpall_one.obs["batch"] = (
    carpall_one.obs["file_id"]
    .str.extract(r"count_(\d+)_CAR")
)
```

```{python}
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(
    carpall_one, 
    n_top_genes=2000, 
    flavor="cell_ranger", 
    batch_key='batch', 
    layer = 'logcounts',
    subset = False
)
```

# adding controversial scaling step - also allows latent variables such as percent mito to be regressed out
# in seurat scaling is standard, only in scanpy seems an issue and i lean towards including it
```{python}
adata_hvg = carpall_one[:, carpall_one.var.highly_variable].copy()

sc.pp.regress_out(adata_hvg, ["pct_counts_mt"])
sc.pp.scale(adata_hvg)
sc.pp.pca(adata_hvg)
```

```{python}
carpall_one.obsm["X_pca"] = adata_hvg.obsm["X_pca"]
carpall_one.uns["pca"] = adata_hvg.uns["pca"]
```

```{python}
plt.figure()
sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio(carpall_one, n_pcs=50, log=True)
plt.savefig("Elbow_plot.png", dpi=300)
```

```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(carpall_one, n_pcs=12)
sc.tl.umap(carpall_one, random_state=2026)
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(20,20))
sc.pl.umap(carpall_one, color=["batch", "Patient", "Timepoint_bin", "Sort"], 
wspace=0.5,show=True, size = 2, ncols=2)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("UMAP_uncorrected.png",dpi=300)
```

```{python}
carpall_one.obs["patient_timepoint"] = (
    carpall_one.obs["Patient"].astype(str)
    + "_"
    + carpall_one.obs["Timepoint_bin"].astype(str)
)
```


# trying harmony instead
```{python}
pcs = carpall_one.obsm["X_pca"]
print(pcs.shape)
```

```{python}
batch_patient_structure = pd.crosstab(
    carpall_one.obs["batch"],
    carpall_one.obs["patient_timepoint"]
)
```

```{python}
harmony_out = hm.run_harmony(pcs, carpall_one.obs, "batch")
```

```{python}
# Store corrected PCs back in the AnnData object
carpall_one.obsm['X_pca_harmony'] = harmony_out.Z_corr
sc.pl.pca_variance_ratio(carpall_one, n_pcs=50, log=True)
```

```{python}
# Use harmonized PCs for downstream analysis
sc.pp.neighbors(carpall_one, use_rep='X_pca_harmony', n_pcs=13)
sc.tl.umap(carpall_one)
```

```{python}
fig = sc.pl.umap(carpall_one, color=["batch", "Patient"], 
wspace=0.5,show=False, size = 2, ncols=2,frameon = False, return_fig = True)
fig.set_size_inches(14, 6)
print(fig.get_size_inches())
fig.savefig("umap_harmony.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close
```

# checking cell cycle genes
```{python}
s_genes = [
    'MCM5','PCNA','TYMS','FEN1','MCM2','MCM4','RRM1','UNG',
    'GINS2','MCM6','CDCA7','DTL','PRIM1','UHRF1','HELLS',
    'RFC2','RPA2','NASP','RAD51AP1','GMNN','WDR76','SLBP',
    'CCNE2','UBR7','POLD3','MSH2','ATAD2','RAD51','RRM2',
    'CDC45','CDC6','EXO1','TIPIN','DSCC1','BLM','CASP8AP2',
    'USP1','CLSPN','POLA1','CHAF1B','BRIP1','E2F8'
]

g2m_genes = [
    'HMGB2','CDK1','NUSAP1','UBE2C','BIRC5','TPX2','TOP2A',
    'NDC80','CKS2','NUF2','CKS1B','MKI67','TMPO','CENPF',
    'TACC3','FAM64A','SMC4','CCNB2','CKAP2L','CKAP2',
    'AURKB','BUB1','KIF11','ANP32E','TUBB4B','GTSE1',
    'KIF20B','HJURP','CDC20','TTK','CDC25C','KIF2C',
    'RANGAP1','NCAPD2','DLGAP5','CDCA3','HMMR','AURKA',
    'PSRC1','ANLN','LBR','CKAP5','CENPE','CTCF','NEK2',
    'G2E3','GAS2L3','CBX5','CENPA'
]

s_present = [g for g in s_genes if g in carpall_one.var_names]
g2m_present = [g for g in g2m_genes if g in carpall_one.var_names]

print(len(s_present), len(g2m_present))
```

```{python}
sc.tl.score_genes_cell_cycle(
    carpall_one,
    s_genes=s_present,
    g2m_genes=g2m_present
)
```

```{python}
fig=sc.pl.umap(
    carpall_one,
    color=["S_score", "G2M_score", "phase"],size=1,ncols =1, frameon=False,
    return_fig=True, cmap="rocket")

fig.set_size_inches(6, 10)
fig.savefig("umap_cell_cycle.png", dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close
```

```{python}
for res in [0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,0.9,1,1.5,2]:
    sc.tl.leiden(carpall_one, key_added = "leiden_res_" + str(res), resolution = res, 
    flavor = "igraph", n_iterations = 2, directed = False)
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(
    carpall_one,
    color=["leiden_res_0.5",
     "leiden_res_1", "leiden_res_1.5"], 
    size = 10, legend_fontsize="x-large", ncols=1, wspace=0.5
)
```

```{python}
sc.pl.dotplot(carpall_one, groupby="leiden_res_1", var_names=["CD3D", "CD3E", "CD8A", "CD8B", "CD4", "NCAM1", "LYZ", "CD14", "CD68", "CD79A", "MZB1", "PAX5", "CD34"])
```

```{python}
sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(
    carpall_one, groupby="leiden_res_1", method="wilcoxon", key_added="dea_leiden_res_1"
)
```

```{python}
sc.tl.dendrogram(
```
